name: Gloom Punks
description:
About This Game

Death isn’t a setback, it’s how punks like you cheat fate. In Gloom Punks, every death fuels evolution, every sacrifice unlocks absurd perks, powers, and playstyles, and every run takes you deeper into worlds that don’t want you to leave.

You start in a prison of gluttonous madness and claw your way out—only to find kingdoms frozen in curses, deserts crawling with monstrosities, and landscapes that feel like fairytales gone feral. Every environment brings a new flavor of mayhem!

Go solo, or drag a few unlucky souls down with you! Up to 4-player co-op means more synergies, more chaos, and more reasons to shout at your friends when everything goes sideways. Of course it wasn’t your fault!

Raise pets to fight alongside you—or just to flex on your party. From rats and goblins, to centaurs, wolves, and a literal walking cheese block, all of them are ready to claw, bite, and look…unsettlingly adorable while doing it.

Weapons, items, armor, and trinkets galore! Whether you’re a collector (or just a hoarder), you’ll have your pick of the litter, from the less bizarre, to the wildly absurd!

Forge gear, build your base, unlock perks, and when you hit the wall? Step into the fire, rebirth, and crawl back meaner, faster, stranger. Progression never stops—it just mutates.

Key Features

  • Rebirth: Sacrifice to unlock twisted perks and fresh playstyles.

  • Co-Op Chaos (Up to 4): Synergies, betrayals, and loot goblin glory.

  • Pets with Bite: Hatch, train, and fight alongside your weirdly cute companions.

  • Build Your Base: Craft weapons, raise pets, and flaunt your lair.

  • Endless Loot & Skills: No two rebirths ever the same.
short_desc: Not your average co-op roguelike. Where the price for power is death, and you’re trapped in a gloom-scape of fever dreams and fairytales gone feral, you can only rely on Punks like yourself. Cheat death, bounce back, and take on a world that so badly wants you dead!
